description.value: Obanhmi is a Vietnamese bánh mì chain with 9 locations across BC, serving signature sandwiches stuffed with house-made fillings, fresh spring rolls, and rich iced coffee. The Hastings Street location has built a loyal following for its fast, friendly service and accessible online ordering with quick in-store pickup. The menu spans classic pork and chicken options through to fully vegan and halal choices, making it a welcoming stop for riders with varied dietary needs.
